claims.text: The hotel is in the heart of Downtown Palo Alto, in Silicon Valley.

findings.quote: Stay in the heart of Downtown Palo Alto, a sun-soaked Silicon Valley city

claims.text: Downtown Palo Alto has walkable, tree-lined streets with open-air cafes, farmers' markets, theatres and bookstores.

findings.quote: Downtown Palo Alto embodies small-town charm with its walkable streets and tree-lined avenues, dotted with open-air cafés, farmers’ markets, theatres, bookstores

claims.text: The interior, created by Montalba Architects, is defined by neutral hues, natural materials and minimalist style.

findings.quote: Our interior—created by Montalba Architects—is defined by neutral hues, natural materials, and minimalist style.

claims.text: Spaces are designed to integrate indoor and outdoor areas so guests can enjoy the city's weather.

findings.quote: Each space is designed to seamlessly integrate indoor and outdoor areas for guests to enjoy the city’s incredible weather.

claims.text: Rooms feature the signature Nobu bed and linen yukata.

findings.quote: Signature Nobu bed
Linen yukata

claims.text: Rooms come with Natura Bisse bath amenities and complimentary Nespresso and Ikaati tea.

findings.quote: Natura Bissé bath amenities
Complimentary Nespresso and Ikaati tea

claims.text: Service is infused with Omotenashi, the Japanese spirit of hospitality.

findings.quote: Thoughtful, attentive service infused with Omotenashi, the Japanese spirit of hospitality.

claims.text: The Nobu Palo Alto restaurant serves Chef Nobu Matsuhisa's signature dishes, such as Black Cod Miso, alongside California-inspired plates and exclusive sakes unique to Palo Alto.

findings.quote: The Nobu Palo Alto menu is defined by the inspired flavors and innovative dishes mastered by Chef Nobu Matsuhisa.

Enjoy signature dishes in the dining room or at the exclusive sushi bar—including Black Cod Miso and Yellowtail Sashimi—alongside offerings unique to Palo Alto, including California-inspired plates and exclusive sakes.

claims.text: On weekends, afternoon tea is served with Ikaati Tea in the Japanese-inspired garden.

findings.quote: Zen ambiance is paired with Ikaati Tea in our Japanese-inspired garden.

Saturday & Sunday

12:00 PM – 3:30 PM
findings.note: afternoon tea hours listed Saturday and Sunday

claims.text: A 24/7 fitness center on the second floor has Technogym equipment.

findings.quote: a private sanctuary for wellness enthusiasts located on our second floor
Discover an elevated, 24/7 workout experience in our fitness center featuring innovative Technogym equipment

claims.text: Children under 12 stay free with an accompanying adult, and cribs are available on request at no additional charge.

findings.quote: Children under 12 years of age stay free with an accompanying adult and cribs are available upon request at no additional charge.

claims.text: Stanford University's campus, Filoli Historic House and Gardens and Baylands Nature Preserve are nearby.

findings.quote: Lush nature and green spaces are also nearby
from the sprawling grounds of Stanford University’s prestigious campus to the stunning landscape of the Filoli Historic House & Gardens, and undisturbed natural habitats of Baylands Nature Preserve

claims.text: The hotel's design centerpiece is its garden, connected to the Nobu Palo Alto restaurant, which merges craftsmanship with traditional Japanese elements.

findings.quote: Our hotel’s design centerpiece is our garden, a lush sanctuary connected to Nobu Palo Alto that merges curated craftsmanship with traditional Japanese elements

claims.text: Accommodations include Ryokan rooms and suites alongside guest rooms and suites.

findings.quote: Guest Rooms, Suites & Ryokan Accommodations
Ryokan Room
Ryokan Suite

claims.text: The exterior has a wood facade inspired by Northern California, complemented by a custom mural of El Palo Alto.

findings.quote: The exterior’s sleek wood façade is inspired by our Northern California home, complemented by a custom mural of El Palo Alto.

claims.text: The hotel embodies the Japanese philosophy of Shiawase, a celebration of happiness and well-being.

findings.quote: Nobu Hotel Palo Alto embodies the Japanese philosophy of Shiawase — a celebration of happiness and well-being

claims.text: The spa partner, Watercourse Way Bath House Spa, offers private hot tub rooms with steam or sauna facilities and massages.

just five-minutes walking distance from the hotel
